name_zh: 罗梅罗/萨尔瓦多/大主教/解放/殉道/圣人/奥斯卡/真相/弥撒
core_mode: M606 解放神学/大主教殉道/真相委员会/圣人/弥撒遇刺
description_zh: 奥斯卡·罗梅罗（1917-1980），萨尔瓦多前大主教，1974-1980年在位。他是一位天主教神父，通过传播解放神学的思想和支持萨尔瓦多人民的权利，领导了萨尔瓦多的解放斗争。他呼吁为萨尔瓦多人民的解放和正义而奋斗，并反对政府的镇压。在1980年的一次弥撒中，罗梅罗遇刺身亡，成为殉道者。他的殉道精神激励了萨尔瓦多人民的解放斗争。
description_en: Óscar Romero (1917-1980), former Archbishop of El Salvador, served from 1974 to 1980. He was a Catholic priest who spread the ideas of liberation theology and led El Salvador's liberation struggle by supporting the rights of El Salvador's people. He called for El Salvador's people's liberation and justice and opposed government repression. During a mass in 1980, Romero was assassinated and became a martyr. His martyrdom inspired El Salvador's people's liberation struggle.
reason_zh: 罗梅罗是萨尔瓦多天主教神父，通过传播解放神学的思想和支持萨尔瓦多人民的权利，领导了萨尔瓦多的解放斗争。他的殉道精神激励了萨尔瓦多人民的解放斗争，体现了天主教会对社会正义的追求。
reason_en: Romero was a Salvadoran Catholic priest who spread the ideas of liberation theology and led El Salvador's liberation struggle by supporting the rights of El Salvador's people. His martyrdom inspired El Salvador's people's liberation struggle, exemplified Catholic Church's pursuit of social justice.
